flags.title: Many Venetian structures do not state entry caps
flags.finding: The sheets publish event details and structures, but most do not establish one total entry or all no-extra-spend rules. Multi-flight rows are separated.
flags.nextStep: Ask for the event-number-specific entry limit and full rules before registering.

flags.title: Bellagio Saturday NLH source conflict
flags.finding: The current page says $1,000; linked PDF header says $1,100, its fee allocation says $600, and its Day 2 date is Sept. 13, 2026. The event is excluded and values are blank.
flags.nextStep: Get a current dated Bellagio structure and reconcile the exact fee and flights.

flags.title: No hotel has a valid exact-date checkout total
flags.finding: The shared sample is Dec. 10–14, 2026 for two adults. Venetian showed placeholders, Wynn returned different dates, Horseshoe returned a technical error, and no other date-matched quote was captured.
flags.nextStep: Obtain direct checkout totals for identical stay dates, occupancy and room category; itemize room, tax, resort fee, parking and cancellation terms.

flags.title: Walking estimates are not verified at venue entrances
flags.finding: Third-party routes provide approximate times; same-property routes are unmeasured. The 30-minute filter does not certify accessibility or entrance-to-room travel.
flags.nextStep: Verify exact guest and poker-room access points using a current pedestrian route before relying on the filter.

flags.title: No playable sequence is established
flags.finding: Start times, level lengths and registration cutoffs do not establish a future finish time or realistic exit window. Primary/fallback choices are planning aids only.

flags.title: ARIA cadence is undated
flags.finding: The official guide lists daily 1 PM / nightly 7 PM, but the current operation, buy-in, guarantee and full entry rules are not date-confirmed.

flags.title: Hotel comparison dates are a research sample

flags.title: Wynn historical $50 fee offer is expired
flags.finding: A Wynn offer/terms page reviewed for the earlier fee discrepancy was limited to a 2025 stay period. It is retained as historical context only; the current resort-information source states $55 plus tax. The fee on a future booking is controlled by the exact room offer.
flags.nextStep: Use the resort fee and parking terms attached to the actual dated reservation; do not use the expired offer as a current rate.

flags.title: Some Venetian parsed dates rely on omitted-date row order
